tasks.description: Add `recordNotRun` / `record-not-run` and `readOutcome` / `read-outcome` to `functional-verification.js`, with Jest tests. Serves O1, O2. Dependencies: none. Acceptance: record-not-run writes verification-state.json with outcome not-run and the reason, and verification-report.md with matching Reason and Source PRD lines; missing --reason exits 1 and writes nothing; over a state file with outcome null it writes the report and leaves the state byte-identical (stateKept true); read-outcome reports fresh false for a state file older than the latest run's started_at and fresh true for one written after; tests fail on today's code.

implement-trd.md (both copies): section 3.6 always passes the source by path and records derive_dispatched; section 8.1 re-derives once in the foreground (mirroring /verify-build 3a) and both not-run exits call record-not-run; section 8.1a blocking-policy exit calls it; Step 8 states the loop is not substitutable; Step 9's --verified close requires read-outcome to return satisfied and fresh; Step 9 ISSUES names the not-run reason; the two copies are byte-identical. Serves O1, O2, O3. Dependencies: FIX-001.

plan.md (both copies) Step 7: the chained /implement-trd runs its own loop and nothing substitutes for it; verify-build.md (both copies) 3a passes the source by path. Serves O1, O3. Dependencies: none.

verify-functional.js (both copies): one setup-recheck after a first setup-failure; Exercise prompt repeat-once rule; update and add workflow tests. Serves O4. Dependencies: none. Acceptance: a plan whose setup returns setup-failure and whose setup-recheck returns proceed reaches Exercise; a re-check that also fails ends setup-failure with the re-check's problems and labels ['setup','setup-recheck','record']; a dead re-check keeps the first problems; a re-check reporting refreshesRun > 0 is rejected; the Exercise prompt carries the repeat-once rule; existing setup tests pass with updated label lists.

Prose test over implement-trd.md, plan.md and verify-build.md for FIX-002/FIX-003. Serves O1, O2, O3. Dependencies: FIX-002, FIX-003. Acceptance: packages/core/commands/verification-not-run-prose.test.js fails against the commit before FIX-002/FIX-003 and passes after.
